YOI-BOI: Your DAW keeps its keys: space, Return, Tab, letters and Cmd-Z reach it while you tweak. The arrow keys browse the Library view you're on.
The search box lets go of the keyboard after Return or a click elsewhere. Space no longer clicks the vowel path.
The vowel path shows that it can be clicked to shape it. Bounces render at your project's sample rate.
Locked controls stay put when you change presets (LOAD, arrows or the die). LENGTH and SUB start locked; click a padlock to let presets set them.
THROW-UP: Your DAW keeps its keys. The arrow keys step through presets, factory and yours, with the preset box always naming the one you hear.
THROW! can no longer stick on when the window closes mid-hold.
Safer project saves in hosts that save from a background thread.
BACK-SCRATCH: Your DAW keeps its keys, Cmd-Z included. The arrow keys browse presets like the screen's arrows, into the selected slot. Escape only cancels what's open.
Long status messages wrap instead of squeezing.
The plug-in's BYPASS and your DAW's bypass are now one switch.
A locked phrase keeps its length and timing when you change presets too; each preset's pattern fits that length.
SHIFTY: Your DAW keeps its keys, Cmd-Z included. The arrow keys browse the PRESETS list, as filtered, from any page.
Typed values understand units ("1 s", "2 kHz") and vowel names. Tooltips use plain names.
The preset list scrolls smoothly with a trackpad. The star is off for sounds that aren't saved yet.
The plug-in's BYPASS and your DAW's bypass are now one switch.
Locked controls, and a locked engine, stay put when you change presets. OUTPUT and BYPASS start locked; unlock them to let presets set them.
ENERGY HARVESTER: Your DAW keeps its keys. The arrow keys browse presets; they no longer nudge a fader you clicked.
A window resized by dragging its corner keeps its size. Loading a preset keeps your project's sound setting.
The STOP>START mode has one name everywhere.
STUTTER-STEP: New DRAG MIDI key: drag it onto a MIDI track to drop the groove as a MIDI clip, swing and ghosts included.
Your DAW keeps its keys: Return can't re-roll NEW GROOVE and Tab reaches your DAW. The arrow keys browse grooves, factory then USER.
The TIME knob shows long LOCK echoes correctly.
A groove name you're typing survives clicking into your DAW.
Hosts show the groove you're hearing. Changing SUB SAFE no longer clicks.
